chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaibah, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from al-Hasan ibn Mahb ibn Mahbub, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Indeed, Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) used to say: The emergence of al-Sufyani is inevitable, the call is inevitable, and the rising of the sun from the west is inevitable, and he used to mention many other things as inevitable. Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: And the discord of Bani so-and-so is inevitable, the killing of the Pure Soul is inevitable, and the emergence of the Qa'im is inevitable. I asked: How will the call be? He said: A caller will call from the sky at the beginning of the day, and every people will hear it in their own language: 'Know that the truth is with Ali and his followers.' Then Iblis will call from the earth at the end of the day: 'Know that the truth is with Uuthman and his followers,' at which point the false ones will fall into doubt.

key_terms.إِبْلِيسُ: Iblis (Satan), who will call from the earth in the end times
key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: Al-Sufyani, a key figure in Shia eschatology who emerges before the Mahdi
key_terms.النَّفْسُ الزَّكِيَّةُ: The Pure Soul, often referring to Imam al-Hasan al-Askari (a.s) or the Mahdi
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Qa'im, referring to Imam al-Mahdi (a.s)

ai.seo_question: What are the inevitable signs of the reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.s) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the inevitability (al-Mahmum) of key eschatological events, specifically linking the Sufyani’s emergence and the Zakiyyah’s martyrdom to the final appearance of Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.). It details a unique cosmic phenomenon where a celestial voice affirms the truth with Ali (a.s) while Iblis proclaims it with Uthman (r.a), a duality that sows doubt among the *Mubtilun* (those who distort the truth). This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the political and spiritual contestation preceding the Reappearance.
